post_train_eval: tools/ssenv python -m ss_swag.evaluate --run RUN  (headline = RUN/test_swag.json metrics.nerfw; ss-eval numbers are NOT the paper protocol)
optional_ablations: swag-a (recommended on brandenburg-gate: paper 26.44; smoke shows full swag < swag-a at 2k)
baseline: no shared gsplat baseline exists for phototourism; optionally run gsplat with the same args for reference (full-image metrics, no appearance)
notes: phototourism is not registered in tools/datasets.json; pass --data explicitly or register. Paper targets PSNR: brandenburg-gate 26.33, sacre-coeur 21.16.
